parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of deferred fields not being correctly handled in related queries. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding a copy operation of the deferred fields, which could be optimized or clarified.
